name: TRAPPIST-1b
tagline: A máis interna dos sete mundos resonantes — unha rocha chamuscada do tamaño da Terra.

facts.label: Temperatura
facts.value: ~400 K — too hot for surface water

history: TRAPPIST-1b hugs its ultracool dwarf so tightly that a year lasts a day and a half — inside the orbit where our Mercury would sit, but around a star barely brighter than a giant bonfire. Transits show it is roughly Earth-sized and likely airless or thin-aired: JWST has found no strong atmosphere, consistent with a world baked dry by a flaring young star. Along with its six siblings it forms the longest known resonant chain — the planets' orbits are locked in gravitational harmony, each nudging the others on schedule like gears in a clock.
